title: TTU vs TWU: tuition, size, accreditation
summary: Texas Tech University Health Scienes Center El Paso (TTU) versus Texas Woman's University (TWU). Also searched as TWU vs TTU. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Texas Woman's University and Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso are both public institutions but differ significantly in size and location. Texas Woman's University, located in Denton, has an undergraduate enrollment of 8,767 students, whereas Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso in El Paso enrolls 242 undergraduates. Additionally, Texas Woman's University charges an in-state tuition of $8,640, while Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso does not have a specified in-state tuition. These differences highlight the distinct scale and regional focus of each university.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: Texas Woman's University versus Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso (TWU vs TTU) shows notable differences in cost structure. TWU charges an in-state tuition of $8,640 and an out-of-state tuition of $18,480. In contrast, TTU does not specify tuition amounts for either in-state or out-of-state students. Regarding student debt, the median debt for completers at TWU is $19,218, whereas at TTU it is lower, at $12,500. These figures indicate that while TWU provides clear tuition rates, TTU's cost details are less transparent, and students at TTU tend to graduate with less debt on average.

In summary, TWU versus TTU demonstrates that Texas Woman's University has established tuition fees for residents and non-residents, with higher median student debt, whereas Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso lacks published tuition data but reports a lower median debt among graduates.
